Path: business objects, records and views | records-forms.saved-view-management | P2

## Triage: first grade (family closure card) — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx` (its own `filter` goes into `$filter` with 0 reads of `resolveFilterPlaceholders`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a directly authored `object-gallery` sends `{current_user_id}` literally in its own filter, the objectui#10607 class on a third host. It was read at source with a lit control and has no measured `reach:`. It is also defence in depth, since ObjectStack resolves or refuses the token server-side ⇒ p3. objectui#10607, the family's card, is closed (PR objectui#10656), so this card reopens the family as its closure card rather than dispatching one more single site.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T18:37Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: **first, measure** (a directly authored gallery with the token, through the real `SchemaRenderer`). Then census every node that sends its own `filter` for the missing resolver, and resolve each through the ONE shared `resolveFilterPlaceholders` with `useFilterScope()`, held by structure so nothing refetches every render (PR objectui#10656's shape). ⛔ No second resolver.

- Any other data node that sends its own `filter` into `$filter` without `resolveFilterPlaceholders`. Each one is resolved through the ONE shared resolver with `useFilterScope()`, held by structure, in PR objectui#10656's shape.
- Tests beside each, and one changeset per touched package.

The census names every node it covers. A census hit outside the renderer packages is a breach, and the dev stops to explain it.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`. `dispatch-gates.mjs` refuses objectui, so the gates are derived by hand from objectui's own manifests and workflows.
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5837632474
Serial constraints cleared: open PR file lists read 2026-09-25T19:12Z. No open PR touches `ObjectGallery.tsx`, `resolveFilterPlaceholders` or `useFilterScope`. PR objectui#10656 (objectui#10607), the family's shape, has merged.

Triage (`5837632474`): 「first, measure (a directly authored gallery with the token, through the real `SchemaRenderer`). Then census every node that sends its own `filter` for the missing resolver, and resolve each through the ONE shared `resolveFilterPlaceholders` with `useFilterScope()` … ⛔ No second resolver.」

Why `Clause-②: no`: more hosts honour the spec's context tokens through the existing resolver. No accept set widens, and no export is added.

Skipped ahead of this card:
- objectui#8281 is a contract decision (A–D) that triage says is not a seat's.
- objectui#10657 is serial behind the open PR objectui#10643.
- The p2 skips stand as recorded on the seat post.

## Seat answers — the two questions in the dev report `5838355592`

`domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`, 2026-09-25T19:31Z.

**1. How the 11 remaining nodes are held → B.** One hold is exported from `@object-ui/react` next to `useFilterScope`, and the nodes are fixed in one sweep.

- Governing text: triage `5837632474` asks for 「the ONE shared `resolveFilterPlaceholders` … held by structure … ⛔ No second resolver」. Under A, a hold copied into 9 packages is 9 more copies of the comparator PR objectui#10656 began. C drops the ruled mechanism ("held by structure").
- B is therefore the only option that keeps both the one resolver and the ruled hold. Where the hold lives is a placement call, following this seat's precedent on objectui#10625.
- `Clause-②: yes` for the sweep: `@object-ui/react` gains one hook export. It is additive, and existing callers are unchanged.
- The sweep covers the 11 census nodes in the dev report:
  - `object-calendar`, `object-gantt`, `object-kanban`, `object-map`, `object-timeline`, `object-tree`;
  - `related_list`, `line_items`;
  - `repeater`, the `number` element, `record_picker`.
- `plugin-list`'s internal hook becomes a re-export of, or an import from, the shared one. Only one copy remains.
- The docblocks on the node schemas that say the filter is 「forwarded verbatim as `$filter`」 are corrected in the same sweep. That is the dev's out-of-scope note, and those same docblocks carry it.

**2. The card's status → A.** It stays open as the closure card. PR objectui#10705 keeps `Part of #10666`, and the sweep PR carries `Fixes #10666`.

**Sequence.** This is serial. PR objectui#10705 lands first, and the sweep then goes out under a re-scoped claim.
